title: Network matching
lead: Anagram looks across the network for people who need what you offer, or offer what you need. Nobody learns who you are until you both say yes.
simulated: This network uses the simulated profile. It is for tests and development only. It does not keep your lines private from the operator of the service.
setup_help: Your community organizer gives you the URL of the matching log and the network pins.
pins_bad: These pins are not valid JSON.
lines_title: What you offer, what you need
lines_help: One sentence a line, up to 140 characters. Nothing leaves this computer until you approve it below.
answer_days: You have {days} days to answer a proposal. Your answer goes out on day {first}, {second} or {days} after the proposal, so nobody can see when you chose.
no_cards: No proposals yet. Anagram checks each day.
weekly_cap_help: At most {max} on this network. Choose fewer if you want.
on_status: Your approved lines are in the network. Anagram checks each day.
draft_not_approved: You changed your lines. The network still has the approved ones until you approve the new ones.
off_help: Turning this off takes your lines out of the network. To come back, you approve them again.
chose_yes: You said yes. It goes out after {date}; you can still change it.
chose_no: You said no. It goes out after {date}; you can still change it.
chose_not_now: You said not now. It goes out after {date}; you can still change it.
